original_target.title: Energy conservation at the exact Onsager Hölder exponent

scope_comparison: Isett's actual2024 introduction retains the exact Hölder1/3 endpoint; its solutions approach the exponent with a scale-dependent loss and belong to every subcritical class, not the exact displayed C-time/C1/3-space class. Forced Navier–Stokes critical/subcritical dissipation and vanishing critical Besov tails have different hypotheses. Shared Hexagon Onsager match concerns rods, not Euler.

primary_sources.locator: Forced Navier–Stokes abstract, not unforced Euler endpoint
